{"schema_version":"company_profile_workpaper_draft.v1","elements":{"business_structure":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"BS-01","text":"公司从事绿色低碳综合智慧能源、节能、环保、能源金融等业务投资开发和经营，是广东省重要的综合能源企业之一，为广大客户提供电力、煤炭、天然气、蒸汽、成品油等能源产品和能源管理服务，同时提供天然气、煤炭和油品装卸、运输和储存服务，金融业务主要为能源产业发展提供金融支持。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"BS-02","text":"公司以构建“大产业链”的思路，推动产能互融、多能互补、煤气电联动，形成产、购、销、储、运、用的综合能源产业链；火力发电厂集中在粤港澳大湾区电力负荷中心，是华南地区大型发电企业之一；风力及光伏发电等新能源项目已覆盖全国20个省市。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"BS-03","text":"公司已形成以“燃煤发电及供热”“天然气发电及供热”“新能源及储能”“燃气”“能源物流”五大主业板块的产业布局，同时设立财务公司、融资租赁公司为相关主业提供金融服务；金融业务、其他产业租赁等列为其他分部。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0021"]},{"fact_id":"BS-04","text":"全资子公司燃气集团是广州市城市燃气高压管网建设和天然气购销的主体，拥有基本覆盖广州市全区域的高、中压管网，统筹全市高压管网建设和上游气源采购、下游天然气输配及分销。","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"BS-05","text":"全资子公司能源物流集团是华南地区最大的纵向一体化煤炭经营企业，是全国有影响力的煤炭供应商之一，业务覆盖国内经济发达的20个省市及海外地区，被纳入首批国家电煤重点保供贸易企业；拥有67万立方米大型油库及配套8万吨级石油化工专业码头。","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"BS-06","text":"储能集团在源网荷侧全面布局，已搭建一体化储能电站运维云平台，通过打造“技术研发-场景应用-产业生态”闭环，推动本地储能产业集群化发展。","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]}]},"products_services":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"PS-01","text":"公司提供电力、煤炭、天然气、蒸汽、成品油等能源产品，并提供能源管理服务，同时提供天然气、煤炭和油品装卸、运输和储存服务。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"PS-02","text":"公司电力、蒸汽主要通过所属火力发电机组、风力和光伏发电设备生产；火力发电涵盖燃煤发电、燃气发电、热电联产、分布式能源站。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"PS-03","text":"公司依托涵盖电力、燃气、能源物流、新能源、储能等多元化的综合能源体系，提供源网荷储充一体化、能源托管、节能运维、碳资产管理等一体化服务，构建“投资-建设-运营-增值服务”全链条服务模式。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"]},{"fact_id":"PS-04","text":"公司分产品收入涵盖燃煤发电、天然气发电、煤电热力、气电热力、加气混凝土、煤炭、油品、危化品仓储、天然气、光伏发电、风力发电、充电桩、储能及综合能源、房产租赁、金融业务等。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0007"]},{"fact_id":"PS-05","text":"公司金融业务主要为能源产业发展提供金融支持，实现产融结合；充分发挥财务公司和融资租赁公司专业的金融服务优势，绿色低碳产业基金加快产业布局，并积极推进REITs申报发行工作。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001","source-0002"]}]},"revenue_model":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"RM-01","text":"公司电力主要通过国家电网、南方电网销售给终端用户，积极推进发售电一体运营模式；天然气、煤炭、成品油、蒸汽等通过自有管网、销售平台及运输、批发、销售一体化的产业链等销售给终端用户。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"RM-02","text":"公司天然气、煤炭和成品油等通过外部采购，与国内外知名供应商建立长期战略合作关系，有效控制采购成本。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"RM-03","text":"2025年公司实现营业总收入508.83亿元，营业总成本（含财务公司对外利息、手续费及佣金支出）492.91亿元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0006"],"metrics":[{"name":"营业总收入","raw_value":"508.83","value":"508.83","unit":"亿元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"营业总成本（含财务公司对外利息、手续费及佣金支出）","raw_value":"492.91","value":"492.91","unit":"亿元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"RM-04","text":"主营业务分行业情况显示，能源物流业务营业收入29,485,020,343.45元、毛利率1.10%；天然气业务营业收入10,502,056,882.42元、毛利率13.66%；燃煤发电及供热业务营业收入4,349,947,127.70元、毛利率14.21%；新能源及储能业务营业收入3,245,504,723.82元、毛利率49.30%；天然气发电及供热业务营业收入3,204,831,500.79元、毛利率13.45%；其他产业营业收入95,784,921.17元、毛利率78.02%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0006","source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"能源物流业务营业收入","raw_value":"29,485,020,343.45","value":"29485020343.45","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"能源物流业务毛利率","raw_value":"1.10","value":"1.10","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气业务营业收入","raw_value":"10,502,056,882.42","value":"10502056882.42","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气业务毛利率","raw_value":"13.66","value":"13.66","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"燃煤发电及供热业务营业收入","raw_value":"4,349,947,127.70","value":"4349947127.70","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"燃煤发电及供热业务毛利率","raw_value":"14.21","value":"14.21","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"新能源及储能业务营业收入","raw_value":"3,245,504,723.82","value":"3245504723.82","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"新能源及储能业务毛利率","raw_value":"49.30","value":"49.30","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气发电及供热业务营业收入","raw_value":"3,204,831,500.79","value":"3204831500.79","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气发电及供热业务毛利率","raw_value":"13.45","value":"13.45","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他产业营业收入","raw_value":"95,784,921.17","value":"95784921.17","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他产业毛利率","raw_value":"78.02","value":"78.02","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"RM-05","text":"主营业务分产品情况显示，煤炭营业收入23,064,543,028.53元、毛利率1.29%；油品营业收入6,395,908,933.37元、毛利率0.22%；天然气营业收入10,502,056,882.42元、毛利率13.66%；燃煤发电营业收入3,991,623,307.63元、毛利率13.81%；天然气发电营业收入3,009,223,900.18元、毛利率14.13%；风力发电营业收入2,194,507,260.36元、毛利率52.48%；光伏发电营业收入1,020,539,666.84元、毛利率43.45%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"煤炭营业收入","raw_value":"23,064,543,028.53","value":"23064543028.53","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"煤炭毛利率","raw_value":"1.29","value":"1.29","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"油品营业收入","raw_value":"6,395,908,933.37","value":"6395908933.37","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"油品毛利率","raw_value":"0.22","value":"0.22","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气营业收入","raw_value":"10,502,056,882.42","value":"10502056882.42","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气毛利率","raw_value":"13.66","value":"13.66","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"燃煤发电营业收入","raw_value":"3,991,623,307.63","value":"3991623307.63","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"燃煤发电毛利率","raw_value":"13.81","value":"13.81","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气发电营业收入","raw_value":"3,009,223,900.18","value":"3009223900.18","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气发电毛利率","raw_value":"14.13","value":"14.13","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"风力发电营业收入","raw_value":"2,194,507,260.36","value":"2194507260.36","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"风力发电毛利率","raw_value":"52.48","value":"52.48","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"光伏发电营业收入","raw_value":"1,020,539,666.84","value":"1020539666.84","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"光伏发电毛利率","raw_value":"43.45","value":"43.45","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"RM-06","text":"贸易业务开展情况显示，煤炭本期营业收入23,064,543,028.53元、同比减少5.90%；油品本期营业收入6,395,908,933.37元、同比增长214.00%；天然气本期营业收入3,603,362,079.80元、同比增长0.85%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0011"],"metrics":[{"name":"贸易业务-煤炭本期营业收入","raw_value":"23,064,543,028.53","value":"23064543028.53","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"贸易业务-煤炭营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"-5.90","value":"-5.90","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"贸易业务-油品本期营业收入","raw_value":"6,395,908,933.37","value":"6395908933.37","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"贸易业务-油品营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"214.00","value":"214.00","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"贸易业务-天然气本期营业收入","raw_value":"3,603,362,079.80","value":"3603362079.80","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"贸易业务-天然气营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"0.85","value":"0.85","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]}]},"scale_and_mix":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"SM-01","text":"截至2025年12月31日，公司发电装机容量达到1,097万千瓦，其中火力发电可控装机容量为484万千瓦，风力及光伏发电可控装机容量为613万千瓦，绿色低碳能源装机
